description: This file defines a Java class SmsMessageApiResponseData which models the response data structure for an outbound SMS message API. It includes HTTP status code and a list of delivery reports, and provides a static factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: SmsMessageApiResponseData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing an outbound SMS message API response data.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SmsMessageApiResponseData with specified HTTP status code and list of delivery reports.
